scope: USA native projectile update hook ABIs, first-update lifecycle and display visibility correction. No binaries are included.

nativeEvidence.finding: Ghidra decompilation and wrapper disassembly establish native task/object arguments, float offsets and thresholds, Yae homing mode forwarded in unchanged a1, and unsigned halfword trail interval. First-update timer predicates are 0 for coin/charged, 90 for Yae and 60 for kunai; delayed bomb/camera initializers enter phase 0 and produce pose at phase 1. Returned impact phases are excluded by capture regression tests.

Five arguments; a0 points to three packed unsigned halfwords; a1 points to three floats; a2/a3/fifth stack slot are masked or loaded at unsigned16 width. Output old angles are read before native adjustment; void return. Full main symbol size 0x370 verified from current syms.

USA big-endian kind-2 template bytes at +64 are 00 01 00 00 and kind+4=82. Pool reset copies template; allocation clears +4&7f only. Native draw LB+65 then BGEZ accepts 0 and positive values. Exact-zero capture rejected ordinary visible projectiles. High bit 0x80 is set by task removal helper, not proven a normal live render phase.

Native impact model 0x19000420, scale 0.3 from 0x3E99999A; trail scale delta 0.006 from 0x3BC49BA6. Impact alpha 255 fades by 24, trail alpha 240 fades by 30. Texture table has A007980,A008180,A013980,A014180,A014980,A015180,A015980,A016180 each 3 ticks, then a zero sentinel. Lifetime ends from native model frame count or trail exhaustion.

Native list allocation appends through task +0x1C while preserving an existing primary record at +0x18. Frame-count helper resolves the bound model header and returns its low eight bits, with only DAT_801684F0 resolver scratch written. Descriptor scalar review: kunai 0x80204DD0 selects model 0x49008220, direct material 0x8006D920, scale 0.16, mode 5; Yae 0x80204D70 selects model 0x4900A350, the same direct material, scale 0.1, mode 5; trail 0x80204DA0 selects model 0x490026B0, scale 0.03, mode 10. Material tag table 0x80204B78 is 0,0x10000000,0x20000000,0x30000000: Ebisumaru index 2 selects the A-tagged pointer. Native coin mode 2 persists through impact; bomb primary mode 7 and secondary mode 5 use an A-tagged material context, while Yae impact uses an E-tagged context. Reviewed by sibling native_collision against Ghidra and USA ROM scalar reads; no game binaries copied.

limitations: Deterministic host fixtures and MIPS compilation do not establish live two-client rendering.
Zero or invalid direction behavior for func_8001DB04_1E704 was not established.
The former full-snapshot material arena failure was a possible all-drop guard but was not observed failing at runtime.

Current local simulation uses a fixed charged-coin return origin and one Yae trail without a target-dependent homing decision; these are implementation limits, not claims that the native actor has the same limits.
